title: CAS-06697 — Prime Time — RTÉ One
text:
Programme: Prime Time
Broadcast / VOD service: RTÉ One
Date broadcast or accessed: 22.01.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Section 46L(1)(b) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Short description: The complaint is about a debate on insurance company Allianz’s sponsorship of the GAA. The complaint alleges that statutory standards for fairness, objectivity and impartiality were not met on the basis that the non-disclosure of a guest’s relationship with Allianz was misleading to the audience.
Outcome: Referred
Commission Decision: Refer the complaint to an authorised person to be considered for investigation, pursuant to s48(5) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 23.04.2026
